subtitle: Checkpoint after Units 7–9 · the ExamView L4U7–9 test · 13 parts · 42 questions · 80 points · no right/wrong shown while answering

content: Answer the Units 7–9 listening sections from TR 9.3, TR 9.4 and TR 9.4a.
Use the Units 7–9 vocabulary — inventions, hobbies and forces — in a word box and in two-answer questions.
Read the two passages and answer with true/false, matching, and complete sentences.
Write 3 to 4 sentences about a hobby or a favourite invention, and answer the ten speaking prompts from the picture.
language: Use used to and didn't use to for past habits that have changed.
Define a person with who and a thing or animal with which.
Rewrite with send something to someone and buy something for someone.
Link two changes with the double comparative the more… the more…
